build_Conversion: build a Conversion instance with an MHR model and SMPL model to enable bidirectional body model conversion
run_convert_smpl2mhr: run convert_smpl2mhr to convert SMPL vertices or parameters into MHR model parameters and meshes
run_convert_mhr2smpl: run convert_mhr2smpl to convert MHR vertices or parameters into SMPL model parameters and meshes
run_convert_sam3d_output_to_smpl: run convert_sam3d_output_to_smpl to convert SAM3D body estimator output into SMPL model parameters
run_compute_target_vertices: run _compute_target_vertices to map vertices between SMPL and MHR mesh topologies using barycentric interpolation
